about: KIBO offline speech-recognition comparison. Synthetic Gemini TTS speech, not real people. Non-Google systems are an offline comparison, not used in the product.

voices.note: mature voice, slow elderly style tag

gemini-live.label: Gemini Live gemini-3.8-live, minimal instruction, inputAudioTranscription {} (the product's transcription setting)

gemini-live-vocab.label: Gemini Live gemini-3.8-live + languageCodes + customVocabulary (menu names)

gemini-live-menu.label: Gemini Live gemini-3.8-live + menu names in system instruction (closest to the product, whose instructions carry the full menu data)

chirp3.label: Cloud Speech-to-Text v2 Chirp 3 (chirp_3, location us)

chirp3-hints.label: Cloud Speech-to-Text v2 Chirp 3 + inline phrase set (menu names, boost 10)

openai-batch.label: OpenAI gpt-transcribe batch (offline comparison, not used in the product)

openai-realtime.label: OpenAI gpt-live-transcribe realtime (offline comparison, not used in the product)

mai-transcribe-2.label: Microsoft MAI-Transcribe-2 fast transcription REST (offline comparison, not used in the product)

mai-transcribe-2-hints.label: Microsoft MAI-Transcribe-2 + phraseList (menu names) (offline comparison, not used in the product)

mai-voicelive.label: Microsoft MAI-Transcribe-2 via Azure Voice Live streaming (offline comparison, not used in the product)
